title: Garganon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Garganon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Garganon is a fire-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Vitality (B), Defense (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Garganon
sections.content:
Location: Inside the Monolith - merchant Melosh.

Obtained from Inside the Monolith - merchant Melosh.

sections.title: Is the Garganon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Defense (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
